description: Attach one file to a campaign the caller's organization owns: a PDF, a GIF, JPEG, PNG, or WebP image, a CSV, a JSON, or a plain text file, at most 4 MB, sent as base64. The campaign, the organization, and the user each have a file limit, and uploads per hour are limited; past either it returns a tool error naming the reason. A campaign outside the organization returns not_found. Needs a credential.

content.description: The file bytes in base64, at most 4 MB once decoded

contentType.description: The media type of the file

fileName.description: The file name with its extension, such as brief.pdf

name: upload_campaign_attachment
title: Upload campaign file
